Yup 6 months is absolutely enough time, especially when you can already run a 10k. In that amount of time you'll be able to get in a really strong base and hit tons of 18+ mile runs (the more the better in my opinion). Your last three weeks should be devoted to recovering and tapering (which is why I find a month long training schedule to be absolutely insane). The marathon is a really rewarding challenge and part of the reason I've suffered in the past is because my weekly mileage wasn't high enough. If you get this high enough (45+ mpw) which is very doable for ~6 months of training you'll make it through just fine! My first maxed at 40mpw and I still ran sub 4, but at mile 23 I really wished I'd upped the mileage a bit more.
